seo.title: Amabhizinisi · ChatSched
seo.description: Bhuka abashicileli nabadidiyeli bangempela baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuqondile — ayikho i-akhawunti yokukhangisa, ayikho ukubhida, ayikho i-alghorithm. Inkokhelo igcinwa kwi-escrow, imikhankaso elandelelwayo, ubufakazi uma isisebenza.

hero.title: Finyelela izilaleli osezizethemba amakhasimende akho.
hero.subtitle: I-ChatSched ixhumanisa amabhizinisi amancane aseNingizimu Afrika ngqo namakhasi, abadidiyeli namashaneli amakhasimende awo asewalandela — ayikho i-alghorithm, ayikho i-akhawunti yokukhangisa, ayikho impi yokubhida. Ukhokha kuphela uma umuntu wangempela eseqinisekise ukuthi ukuboniswa kwakho kuyasebenza.

howItWorks.title: Kusukela esicelweni kuya ekusebenzeni, ngezinyathelo ezine.

steps.title: Thola ishaneli lakho
steps.body: Bheka amakhasi omphakathi, izikhulumeli, amawebhusayithi, ama-podcast namaqembu omsakazo ngesigaba, isifundazwe nezilaleli ukuze uthole okufanele amakhasimende akho.

steps.title: Thumela isicelo
steps.body: Khetha umshicileli bese uthumela isicelo sokuboniswa esichaza ofuna ukukukhangisa — ayikho umphathi we-akhawunti, ayikho i-akhawunti yokukhangisa, asikho isamba esiphansi.

steps.title: Khokha kwi-escrow
steps.body: Uma umshicileli evumile, khokha ngokuphepha ngekhadi, i-EFT esheshayo, noma i-EFT eyenziwa ngesandla. Imali ihlala ne-ChatSched — hhayi umshicileli — kuze kube ukuboniswa kuyasebenza ngempela.

steps.title: Thola ubufakazi, hhayi izithembiso
steps.body: Bheka isicelo sakho sisuka ekuthunyelweni siye ekusebenzeni, unobufakazi uma sekuphelile. Asikho ukuqagela ukuthi isabelomali sakho siye kuphi.

channels.title: Bhuka noma yikuphi lapho amakhasimende akho ekhona.
channels.subtitle: Ishaneli ngalinye ngezansi lisebenza ngohambo olufanayo olulula lwesicelo-nokuvuma — khetha lawo afanele.

tools.title: Isethi ephelele yokukhangisa, hhayi nje uhlu.
tools.subtitle: Uma usubhalisile, lawa mathuluzi ahlala ebhodini lakho ehambisana nezicelo zakho.

items.name: Audience Finder
items.body: Describe your business in plain language — get a ranked list of publishers who actually fit.

items.name: Umhleli Wokufinyelela
items.body: Isihlahlandlela esiqondisayo esiguqula umgomo ube uhlelo nesheduli.

items.name: Isitudiyo Sokuqukethwe se-AI
items.body: Isithombe esisodwa noma umbiko kube amafomethi ayisishiyagalolunye asekulungele ukuthunyelwa — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, nokunye.

items.name: Umakhi Womkhankaso
items.body: Guqula umbiko olula ube umkhankaso onamaphuzu, kanye neziphakamiso zokuwenza ngcono.

items.name: Umlandeleli Womkhankaso
items.body: Izixhumanisi zangempela zokulandelela umkhankaso ngamunye — ukuchofoza, ukuvakasha, abaholele kanye nokuguqulwa, hhayi izilinganiselo.

items.name: Isibali-ROI
items.body: Faka isabelomali, uthole ukufinyelela okulinganiselwe nembuyiselo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela.

items.name: Caption Writer
items.body: Describe the promotion once, get channel-ready captions back — no rewriting for every placement.

items.name: Media Kit
items.body: Build the one-page kit a publisher or partner needs to say yes in a single look.

rows.us: Uyazi ncamashi ukuthi ubani okukhangisayo nokuthi kungani efanele amakhasimende akho.
rows.them: Isikhangiso sakho siqhudelana ngokunakwa ngaphakathi kwe-alghorithm engaziwa.

rows.us: Abashicileli bahlolwa ngesandla ngaphambi kokuba baliswe.
rows.them: Izinombolo zokufinyelela zibikwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi azihlale ziqinisekiswa.

rows.us: Inkokhelo ihlala kwi-escrow kuze kube ukuboniswa kuqinisekisiwe kuyasebenza.
rows.them: Ukhokha kusengaphambili bese uthembela ekutheni i-alghorithm izokuletha.

rows.us: Amashaneli endawo, athembekile amakhasimende akho asewalandela.
rows.them: Kuvinjwa kancane kancane izivimbeli zezikhangiso futhi kunganakwa ngenxa yokungabonakali kwamabhena.

escrowStrip.title: 🔒 Imali ayihambi kuze kuhambe umsebenzi
escrowStrip.body: Inkokhelo yakho ihlala kwi-escrow — hhayi nomshicileli — kuze kube ukuboniswa kwakho kuqinisekisiwe kuyasebenza. Umshicileli ukhokhwa ngaphakathi kwamahora angu-{{hours}} emva kokuqala ukusebenza. Akekho oyedwa othwala ubungozi.

items.a: Asikho isivumelwano nganoma iyiphi indlela. Ukubheka kuhlale kumahhala — ukuthumela isicelo kudinga ukwenziwa kanye kwe-ChatSched Business (R399, kanye kuphela — ayibuyi nanini), okuvula futhi ukukhangisa okuphethwe futhi kufaka isikweletu sokuqalisa esingu-R199.
Umshicileli nomdidiyeli ngamunye uhlolwa ngesandla ngaphambi kokuba baliswe, futhi baphethe amaphuzu okwethenjwa nezinga elakhiwe emlandweni wempela womkhankaso — hhayi nje inombolo yabalandeli.
Uma umshicileli evumile isicelo sakho, unezinsuku ezingu-{{days}} zokukhokha kwi-escrow. Igcinwa lapho — ingakhishelwa umshicileli — kuze kube ukuboniswa kuqinisekisiwe kuyasebenza.
Abashicileli banezinsuku ezingu-{{days}} zokuvuma noma ukwenqaba isicelo. Uma kungenziwanga lutho kuleso sikhathi, siyavaleka ngokuzenzakalelayo — awusoze walinda ingunaphakade.
Amakhasi namaqembu omphakathi, izikhulumeli, amawebhusayithi, ama-podcast namaqembu omsakazo — konke ngohambo olufanayo lwesicelo-nokuvuma.
